premises: These published normalized columns are the known Hesse SIC, with Pi_i=|psi_i><psi_i|. The new consumer does not reconstruct or verify the SIC overlap theorem.
The SIC projectors sum to 3I and satisfy tr(Pi_i Pi_j) = (3 delta_ij + 1)/4; used as inherited measurement premises, not a new Gram check.

consumer.support: Every nonempty subset S of the nine labelled outcomes; p_i = 1/|S| for i in S and zero otherwise.
consumer.visibility: For rational 0 <= t <= 1, p_i(t) = t p_i + (1-t)/9. The corresponding rho(t) = t rho(S) + (1-t)I/3.
consumer.scope: Compatibility of these complete probability vectors; not tomography with unknown missing observations or physical postselection.
consumer.empty_support: Excluded; uniform distribution would be undefined.
